definition: LimitedKnowledge says some agent does not know some sentence. Disagreement says the first agent endorses a sentence and the second does not endorse it; non-endorsement is withholding, not endorsement of negation. Neither condition identifies truth with knowledge or with endorsement. Aristotle’s separately recorded no-truth/unclear-to-us fork has no Lean knowledge-quantifier translation.
note: A minimal stipulated test semantics for #207, not a translation of every historical or modern use. A sourced defense and a translation from ordinary truth claims remain research obligations.
